name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Ground-mode press buffer plus wave release buffer, spam guard, overlay, per-level profiles and practice tools (noclip, speed, freeze, step, checkpoint).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the input buffer on or off.

normal-ticks.name: Default ticks (cube, ball, robot, spider)
normal-ticks.description: Default max press buffer in ticks. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

cube-ticks.name: Cube press ticks
cube-ticks.description: Max press buffer for Cube. -1 = use default ticks.

ball-ticks.name: Ball press ticks
ball-ticks.description: Max press buffer for Ball. -1 = use default ticks.

robot-ticks.name: Robot press ticks
robot-ticks.description: Max press buffer for Robot. -1 = use default ticks.

spider-ticks.name: Spider press ticks
spider-ticks.description: Max press buffer for Spider. -1 = use default ticks.

release-ticks.name: Release ticks (all modes)
release-ticks.description: Delay buffer for button RELEASES in non-wave modes. 0 = off.

wave-release-ticks.name: Wave release ticks
wave-release-ticks.description: Max delay (ticks) before a wave RELEASE is applied. Saved level profiles override this.

spam-guard.name: Spam guard
spam-guard.description: When you click fast (3+ clicks closer than the spam interval) the buffer lets inputs through untouched. Also protects FPS.

spam-interval.name: Spam interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Clicks closer together than this count as spam. 20 ticks = 12 clicks/sec.

overlay.name: Input overlay
overlay.description: Shows the last buffered input and its delay on screen while playing.

practice-buttons.name: Practice buttons
practice-buttons.description: Shows on-screen buttons in Practice Mode: Buffer on/off, Freeze, Step one frame, Checkpoint.

noclip.name: Noclip (practice mode only)
noclip.description: You do not die from obstacles. Only works while playing in Practice Mode, so it never affects normal runs.

game-speed.name: Game speed (practice mode only)
game-speed.description: Speed of the game, from 0.10x (slow motion) to 2.00x. Only applies in Practice Mode.

button-corner.name: Pause button corner
button-corner.description: Where the Buffer button appears in the pause menu.

button-scale.name: Pause button size
button-scale.description: Size of the Buffer button in the pause menu.
